answers.core:
If it's in core it's obvious for every user to use.

The ability for users to listen to "help documentation" to be read back to the user. 

Some big benefits:
1. Stand up and stretch more when you're looking for answers.
2. Users can give their eyes a break from the screen.
3. Users can get up and go get their bevy and snack time.
4. Allows the mid to absorb information in a different cognitive way. 
5. User can think more about the problem while listening to help.
6. More readers.
7. Great way for checking documentation. It's always horrible when someone says there is a typo there or your grammar is wrong. This offers a sanity check for authors of documentation to listen to how their documentation might be read.
answers.workaround: The user can work around this. This is a tool for problem-solving and listening.

title: Read aloud of help documentation for the user
